scope: Bench2Drive SPEED pseudo-sensor frame production only

diagnosis.stock_behavior: Bench2Drive BaseReader produces pseudo sensors from a background-thread floating time-difference test using a strict greater-than comparison at the same nominal 20 Hz frequency as CARLA.
diagnosis.observed_failure_pattern: All CARLA physical sensors and BEV delivered the target frame while SPEED delivered exactly target_frame-1; the strict current-frame bundle then could never complete.

repair_contract.producer_trigger: one stock SpeedometerReader current-state read for each nonzero GameTime frame
repair_contract.cross_tick_read: discard and reread on the new frame

local.command_scope: sensor diagnostics plus Route158 submitter/pair evaluator regression suite

next_gate.requirement: The next separately authorized clean run must record ORION_EXACT_FRAME_SPEEDOMETER=1 and complete with strict same-frame SPEED evidence before the repair is called runtime-validated.

claim_boundary: Engineering root-cause repair with local and cluster-environment unit verification. No live CARLA reliability, model, corruption, UQ, control, or safety result is claimed yet.
